r = requests.get("https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug_view/data/compound/4058/JSON")
data = r.json()

def search_toc(section):
    if isinstance(section, dict):
        if section.get("TOCHeading") == "Hydrogen Bond Donor Count":
            print("Found TOCHeading:", json.dumps(section, indent=2))
        for k, v in section.items():
            search_toc(v)
    elif isinstance(section, list):
        for item in section:
            search_toc(item)
